what: A thin line between sections. At 80% of the screen it draws from the left over 1.6s. When the cursor passes within 50px above or below the line, the middle of the line bends to that spot (twice the distance up or down) over .3s, then on leaving it straightens back with a long wobble over 3s elastic.out(1, .035).

from.where: shared.js [data-divider] — original br-divider (path d follows the cursor in .3s · on leaving 3s elastic.out(1,.035))

note: Line color is --kf-line. On touch devices (no hover) the line only draws, without bending
